mode: Pure deterministic guidance from actual server-owned typed relationship context; existing legacy pattern proposal review improved separately. No new AI/network/write API or numeric policy.

backendAPI.admission: Use validateRequirementRelationshipContext with explicit expected ownership/version selection and recompute evaluateRequirementCoverage. Never accept client-supplied matches/support flags. Derive everything before the existing final owned head/content/source recheck in score-v2-repository typed branch. Add optional jdRecommendations:JdRecommendationPlan to ScoreReadMetadata/read result; preserve old diagnostic/schema/digest bytes and legacy/no-JD branches. No extra RPC/read provider.

envelope.binding: Exact existing available coverage.binding object; no caller substitutes
envelope.digest: SHA256 deterministic complete plan content excluding digest field itself
envelope.items: at most5 objects using itemShape below
envelope.total: all unique nonduplicate reviewable typed clauses represented in the prioritized inventory, not just first5
envelope.remainingCount: total-items.length; preserve unknown/missing requirements in existing complete coverage view
envelope.retainedClauseCount: count of retained unmapped clauses; visible separately, never silently treated as met

itemShape.target: null OR {factId,value,basis:source_quote|candidate_declaration,sourceQuote:string|null}; exact CURRENT contribution value and witness basis only; no historic source substituted for current value
itemShape.reason: bounded source-derived explanation/why this review is useful; no assertions of proficiency, duration or qualification
itemShape.question: null OR bounded question about actual SAME related current contribution and its missing requirement evidence; numbers optional and truthful

ranking: Deterministic required before preferred before contextual/unknown; within importance prioritize unique actual related contributions for review, then partial same-clause clarification, then listings/missing/ambiguous review. Preserve logical AND/OR/negation/importance and approved aliases from coverage. Do not treat contextual, negated or unknown clauses as positive qualifications. Do not select arbitrary first target on ambiguous/multiple placements. Dedup only actual semantic duplicateOf groups; never merge different required/preferred meaning or discard distinct clauses. Top5 is display limit, not complete gap coverage.
truth: Prioritize actually evidenced Python/FastAPI/API/Git work when present. Pydantic/async/microservices/RAG/agents/cloud questions only when SAME real contribution is related under existing admitted same-clause witnesses; otherwise visible evidence gap with no invented link or resume text. A skill listing is not contribution/proficiency/duration. A declaration is labelled and never upgraded to source quote. New facts require existing separate canonical review/confirmation. No automatic application, no new unsupported rewrite.

frontend.readPanel: New JdRecommendations component takes {plan:JdRecommendationPlan,base:string}, type-only server import; mount in score route only when model.jdRecommendations exists, keeping current flags/historical state/ownership/version refs. Show up to5 priorities, exact JD quote/current claim/basis/reason/effort/conditional question; remaining+retained counts and no score promise. Review links exact selected canonical version plus #fact-ID and exact selected JD version; source evidence generic. Clearly label pure local guidance, not AI, independent factual verification or qualification score.
frontend.legacyReview: In existing AuthoringWorkspace show complete current wording beside proposed wording, unchanged source fact IDs/provenance and existing pattern-specific structural rationale/quality warnings. Distinguish projected from saved diagnostics; score/delta remain unavailable. Existing accept/reject/clarify/ack/undo/CAS/proof actions unchanged. Questions remain optional and factual; metrics never mandatory. Add descriptive helper in authoring-ui.ts if useful, preserve existing exports/semantics.

bounds: Existing admitted300clauses/1000witnesses; at most5 rendered recommendations; finite string/array/work/output bounds. Invalid/mismatched/unsafe context refuses through existing private error handling, no partial authoritative output or raw errors/PII logs. Retain deterministic byte-stable output and immutable input.
tests: Known synthetic fixtures and actual production helper/owned reader/UI calls. Reproduce missing capability first with genuine baseline capability or source assertion, not missing-module failure. Independent expected Python/FastAPI evidence versus unsupported Pydantic/RAG/etc, AND/OR/negation/unknown/dedup, stale/wrong owner/source/pair, declaration/fragment/listing/ambiguous placement, top5+complete counts, deterministic/input immutability, and no qualification/score gain. Existing transitions are exercised only with fakeRPC/DOM, no Native claim.
boundary: Source/synthetic/DOM/fakeRPC only; pinned Node22.23.4, sealed empty HOME, OS network/root+WT dotenv/Git-write denial. No parser/DB/env/keys/PII/provider/browser/service/compiler/OCR/Docker/deps/workspace Git/deploy. Default-off flags, IR1.0.4/core602ba/policy230f, all scorer/history/migrations/failures remain fixed.
